senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be lax, hang over,] to be abundant; to be larger, more, better. Sifra K’dosh. beg. יכול שכבוד האב עוֹדֵף וכ׳ you might think that honoring the father was more important than &c.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 876:18">Yalk. Ps. 876</cite> <he>יַעֲדֹף</he>, v. <cite ref="P00144"><he>עָדִיף</he></cite> h.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:7">Midd. IV, 7</cite> <he>האולם עוֹדֵף עליו וכ׳</he> the hall extended beyond it (the Hekhal) fifteen cubits to the north &c.

Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ top [read:] אילו אמר בעיבור הייתי אומר … שההמה עוֹדֶפֶת וכ׳ if he had said b’‘ibbur (by intercalation), I might have said, this refers to the eleven days by which the solar year is larger than the lunar year.
<cite ref="Eruvin 83a">Erub. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>סאה של ירושלמית עודפת וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="J00740"><he>יתירה</he></cite>) the Jerusalem S’ah is larger than … by &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to do more (than enough); to be liberal.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 63a">Kidd. 63ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שמא תַעְדִּיף יתר וכ׳</he> she might do more work for him than is due to him.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 4:14">Tosef. B. Mets. IV, 14</cite> <he>אע״פ שמַעְדִּיפִין זה על זה</he> although one of the partners does more business than the other (they are liberal towards one another). Y. Dem. V, 24ᶜ <he>המַעְדִּיף על מעשרותיו</he> he who adds to his tithes (gives more than one-tenth; <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 8:13">Tosef. Dem. VIII, 13</cite> <he>המרבה במעשרות</he>); a. e.
